observations.content: Assistant researcher returned official British Council Aptis materials; key findings: Overall CEFR = rounded average of the four skill levels (L/R/W/S), G/V gets no CEFR and only breaks grey-area ties; user's Total 174 = sum of 4 skills (48+44+36+46) excluding G/V 40.

Official Aptis cut scores (TR/2020/002): Listening B2=34, C=42; Reading B2=38, C=46; Writing B2=40, C=48; Speaking B1=26, B2=41, C=48. User's previous results: L48=C, R44 = C despite official C starting at 46 (explained as grey-area core bump), W46=C despite official C at 48, S36=B1.

Assistant calculated user's B2 cushions: Listening +14 points (48, needs 34), Reading +6 (44, needs 38), Writing +6 (46, needs 40), Speaking just needs to hold >=26/B1 if other three hold B2; concluded 3 skills C + 1 skill B1 yields Overall C as before, so target B2 is achievable by defense not relearning.

Assistant presented 7-day plan 'Phòng thủ + vá lỗ hổng' (defense + patching gaps) with 70% time to G/V as cheapest lever, 30% Speaking, using user's own materials (Grammar ver 2.docx, VOCABULARY APTIS 1-4, Reading Series 01-04, 17 Listening audio, Writing club samples), plus British Council official practice tests and barem links.

Assistant flagged shift from original assumption: initially planned to push Speaking, but since only Overall B2 needed and math tolerates Speaking at B1, Speaking cut back and G/V + R/W defense prioritized; asked user to confirm if the scoring body looks at individual skills.

User requested pushing Speaking and Writing (Speaking is weakest; Writing sample files can be reused across all task types via memorization to 'write little but score high'); thinks MCQ grammar/vocab/reading test can be passed by random guessing ('khoanh bừa'); wants listening tips/tricks; said most important is writing flowing smoothly ('bài viết viết được mượt').
User clarified: the writing samples in the files he sent are NOT his own writing.

Assistant warned memorizing whole sample essays is penalized with a score of 0 per official British Council barem ('memorised script' = 0); reframed as legal 'frame bank' approach: memorize only skeletons (openings, sign-offs, linkers per register) to fill with topic content, mining the 34 sample files for frames rather than copying.

Assistant corrected user's luck math: grammar MCQ is 3-option so random guessing = 33%, need ~30/50 to reach G/V 40; agreed R/L need only reactivation plus listening tips (pre-read questions, predict info type, audio not verbatim so catch synonyms, use second listen to confirm).

Assistant revised 7-day plan with Speaking+Writing as focus: Day1 score mechanics + writing frame-bank method + timed email-pair homework (~30min); Day2 writing clinic grading vs barem building frame bank from 34 files; Day3 speaking 4 parts x 5 criteria, fluency+linkers B1->B2 lever, S4 don't describe photo, self-record protocol; Day4 speaking drill + listening tips; Day5 G/V gap patching unified conditional formula + word formation + confusables; Day6 reading traps + Part4 heading technique; Day7 full 5-skill official TestReach mock + test-day checklist (CCCD/passport, 3h no break, mic check, typing).
Assistant noted B2 writing is gated by correct register in BOTH letters plus word limit; being 'mượt' (smooth) alone insufficient if register wrong still yields B1.

User confirmed his meaning was memorizing only the outline/frame and default lead-in sentences, provisionally locked the plan ('tạm chốt kế hoạch'), said he'll return later, and asked for a learner profile before starting or to be told if more probing is needed.

Assistant wrote learner profile to APTIS/profile-hoc-vien.md (3332 bytes) capturing: target Overall B2 in ~1 week (exam early Sept 2026); previous 2024-07-20 result G/V40 L48C R44C S36B1 W46C Total174 Overall C; grammar boundary at B2 (past perfect and 3rd conditional solid, mixed conditional wrong due to choosing tense by local time-marker instead of clause purpose, gerund-vs-nominalization hesitation, inversion never seen); vocab B1 floor solid (effect/affect correct, 'obscure' guessed as 'ambitious'); good reading inference; honest learner who chooses 'don't know' over guessing, has own strategies, devalues MCQ; still needs to probe timed writing sample, speaking sample/transcript, and optional 10-question G/V mini-mock to re-baseline the 40.
